blocks.html: CALGARY, ALBERTA:  Face Skin & Body Bar, Calgary’s premier skincare clinic, has recently begun offering Dysport—an injectable neurotoxin that temporarily removes wrinkles and fine lines.  Dysport can be administered on its own or in combination with other treatments as part of a customized treatment plan by gently reducing wrinkle-causing muscles. Dysport not only reduces existing lines but also helps prevent new ones, contributing to a lasting brilliance and overall more youthful appearance.

Co-founded five years ago by Lisane Marins and Heather Dybvig, Face Skin & Body Bar is Calgary’s premier destination for medical aesthetics & integrative skincare.  Staffed by a highly skilled team of Clinical Estheticians and Registered Nurse Injectors, it’s a place where state-of-the-art skincare is precisely tailored to clients’ needs and goals in a spa-like environment.  From skin tightening to acne scar revision and the correction of discolouration, Face Skin & Body Bar is dedicated to helping clients look and feel their very best.  It’s array of cutting-edge treatments includes medical aesthetics (skin tightening, RF microneedling, IPL treatments, microneedling), targeted facial treatments, medical grade peels, laser hair removal, injectables, and much more.

Recently, Face Skin & Body Bar added Dysport to its menu of injectable treatment options.  Like Botox, Dysport contains botulinum toxin type A, a naturally-derived neurotoxin that blocks the nerve signals responsible for wrinkle-causing muscle contractions.  Dysport treatment is often used to target worry lines between the eyebrows (known as glabellar lines), but can also effectively smooth skin and restore a more youthful appearance in other areas of the face.  For consistent wrinkle reduction, treatments are generally repeated every three to four months

Heather Dybvig, the owner of Face Skin & Body Bar, notes that Dysport treatment has already proven to be a popular addition to the clinic’s extensive complement of other skincare services:  “We don’t rely on any one single treatment,” she said.  “Instead, our focus is on curating the right treatment combinations so that we can achieve superior results for each client.  Dysport is one more tool that allows us to bring out our client’s natural beauty with a clear complexion and resilient, wrinkle-free skin.”
For more information about Face Skin & Body Bar and the services it provides, visit https://faceskinandbody.ca.
